policy: External datasets are registry-only inputs. Do not commit downloaded images. Use them for pretraining, camera quality research, fairness audits, or auxiliary validation unless the license explicitly permits product training. Every entry carries an explicit licenseTier read by ml/licensing.py; an entry without one is treated as the most restrictive tier rather than allowed through.

datasets.name: SCIN Skin Condition Image Network
datasets.access: Open download from Google Cloud Storage under the SCIN Data Use License (no registration). The copyright grant has no NonCommercial clause, but the agreement's onward-use terms are unresolved for a shipping product, so shipping purposes need a written position first.
recommendedUse: tone robustness SMOKE TEST only — not an audit set
two weak self-reported signals nothing else in this survey offers: textures_rough_or_flaky (dryness) and condition_symptoms_burning (sensitivity)
risks: 14 Asian cases in the facial subset. A K-beauty model cannot be audited for its own users on this data
only 737 of 5,033 cases are head or neck, and 432 of those are close-ups rather than front-camera frames
353 of the 737 facial cases have AGE_UNKNOWN
no graded label for any ARU axis: conditions are diagnosis presence, with no severity scale in the schema
an inflammatory-rash corpus with a face subset, not a cosmetic corpus

datasets.name: ACNE04
datasets.access: Project repository links Baidu and Google Drive downloads; repository states academic use is free and other use requires contacting the author.
recommendedUse: ordinal-label training experiments that stay separate from ARU cosmetic oil/redness/pores labels
risks: academic-use limitation
acne severity is not equivalent to ARU visible-attribute labels
dataset protocol may not match mobile selfie capture

datasets.name: AcneSCU
datasets.access: Repository provides Baidu download links and states non-commercial use only.
recommendedUse: blemish detector pretraining or negative testing
do not merge into cosmetic-label training without separate license review
risks: commercial use prohibited without permission
acne detection labels do not map to pores/oil/redness directly

datasets.name: WIDER FACE
datasets.access: Public face-detection benchmark; verify current mirror and license before downloading.
recommendedUse: stress tests for pose, scale, occlusion, and lighting
risks: not a skin-quality dataset
no cosmetic labels
privacy/license review required before commercial model use

datasets.name: LaPa Face Parsing
datasets.access: Repository provides Google Drive and Baidu downloads; license text allows non-commercial use only.
risks: non-commercial terms
semantic parsing labels are not oil/redness/pores labels

datasets.name: FFHQ-Wrinkle
datasets.access: Labels are downloadable from the project; source face images derive from FFHQ.
risks: wrinkle labels do not map to ARU oil/redness/pores
check FFHQ and project license terms before any commercial training

datasets.name: Hyper-Skin 2023
datasets.access: Credentialed EULA request required for the dataset; repository code is MIT licensed.
recommendedUse: color constancy and tone proxy validation
risks: small participant count
credentialed access
not a commodity mobile selfie dataset

datasets.name: Fitzpatrick17k
datasets.access: CSV annotations are public; original images come from dermatology atlases and may require form-based access.
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 for the dataset work as stated by the repository.
recommendedUse: dermatology domain pretraining only when license permits
risks: non-commercial license
clinical labels not cosmetic labels
known dataset quality and leakage concerns in later audits

datasets.name: Diverse Dermatology Images
datasets.access: Public clinical-image benchmark described in the paper; verify current distribution terms before use.
recommendedUse: dermatology bias audit, not cosmetic product-label training
risks: clinical imagery
small dataset
medical task mismatch

datasets.name: ISIC 2018 / HAM10000
datasets.access: ISIC Challenge page lists downloads and CC-BY-NC license for 2018 training data.
labels: segmentation masks and metadata depending on task
recommendedUse: medical-domain pretraining only if license permits
do not use for ARU cosmetic recommendations
risks: non-commercial license
dermoscopic lesion images differ strongly from front-camera selfie crops

datasets.name: FaceSkin
datasets.access: Paper describes the dataset; verify availability and license before use.
risks: attribute labels are not cosmetic skin states
availability/license must be verified before integration

datasets.name: MicroGlam
datasets.access: Paper/project dataset; verify release terms before use.
labels: microscopic skin patches under foundation, blusher, highlighter
risks: microscopic capture device differs from phone selfie camera
only 9 participants in paper abstract

datasets.name: SkinCAP
datasets.access: Gated Hugging Face dataset with contact sharing and research-use terms.
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus dataset use agreement.
recommendedUse: explanation/caption style research for non-product internal evaluation
risks: non-commercial and no clinical-care use
raw images require separate access to underlying datasets

datasets.name: AI-Hub 한국인 피부상태 측정 데이터
datasets.access: Korean AI-Hub account plus a usage application, restricted to domestic applicants. The data itself has not been obtained; the tier below governs what may be done once it is.
recommendedUse: the only realistic supervision for a dryness head on Korean faces
an oil scale grounded in sebumeter units rather than annotator taste
risks: access is an application, not a download
controlled capture differs from a phone front camera, so a domain gap remains
the tier rests on an owner attestation; the approved application may attach its own conditions
mono-ethnic with no Fitzpatrick, Monk or ITA field, so it cannot audit its own cross-ethnicity gap
datasets.licenseEvidence: 2026-09-14: the repository owner read the per-dataset 이용약관 on the AI-Hub dataset page (dataSetSn=71645) and reported that commercial training is permitted. This is an owner attestation, not a licence document read by the pipeline — aihub.or.kr is unreachable from the build network, so no text was quoted or archived here. Re-verify against the terms attached to the approved application before weights trained on this data ship.

datasets.name: SkinCon
datasets.access: Concept annotations layered on Fitzpatrick17k and DDI images; inherits their terms.
labels: 48 clinical concepts densely annotated by dermatologists, including erythema
risks: inherits Fitzpatrick17k non-commercial terms
clinical images, not selfies

datasets.name: DDI-2
datasets.access: Stanford School of Medicine Research Use Agreement.
risks: research-use agreement forbids commercial use and derivative works
no erythema field; SkinCon's Erythema overlay covers DDI-1 and Fitzpatrick17k, not DDI-2
Fitzpatrick is a per-patient phototype stratifier, not a pigmentation label
datasets.verifiedRejection: 2026-09-13 survey: adversarial verification found it unusable for ARU.

datasets.name: Derm1M
datasets.access: CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial use requires separate permission.
risks: no pore, wrinkle, sebum or moisture term in the vocabulary
erythema/xerosis/comedo are binary lesion descriptors on diseased skin, not cosmetic grades
datasets.verifiedRejection: 2026-09-13 survey: adversarial verification found it unusable for ARU.

datasets.name: ISGD Indian Skincare and Grooming Dataset
datasets.access: No LICENSE file found in the repository; treat as all rights reserved.
labels: 33 binary attributes, 29 of them hair and grooming
risks: oily_skin is a binary annotator judgment and the worst-performing attribute in the authors' own metrics
images appear web-scraped with no documented consent basis
datasets.verifiedRejection: 2026-09-13 survey: adversarial verification found it unusable for ARU.

datasets.name: PorePatch
datasets.access: No LICENSE file exists.
labels: facial skin patches for local descriptor learning
risks: zero skin-condition annotations of any kind; it is a keypoint-matching benchmark, not a pore-grade dataset
datasets.verifiedRejection: 2026-09-13 survey: adversarial verification found it unusable for ARU.

datasets.name: AI-Hub 스킨케어 성분-효능 추천 데이터 (dataSetSn=71886)
datasets.access: AI-Hub application; the operating institution states non-commercial R&D by default.
risks: supports no ARU camera axis
commercial use needs a separate agreement with the operating institution
datasets.verifiedRejection: 2026-09-13 survey: adversarial verification found it unusable for ARU.

datasets.name: AI-Hub 안면부 피부질환 이미지 합성 데이터 (dataSetSn=71863)
datasets.access: AI-Hub clinical-data track; terms unread because aihub.or.kr was unreachable.
risks: synthetic and disease-oriented
no subject demographics can exist
clinical track carries the heaviest access terms
datasets.verifiedRejection: 2026-09-13 survey: adversarial verification found it unusable for ARU.

datasets.name: AI-Hub K-FACE 한국인 안면 이미지 (dataSetSn=83)
datasets.access: AI-Hub registration; terms unread.
labels: controlled multi-camera face images with pose and illumination variation
risks: no skin labels at all
identifiable biometric data on named individuals engages 개인정보보호법 sensitive-information duties
datasets.verifiedRejection: 2026-09-13 survey: adversarial verification found it unusable for ARU.
